description.zh: 雅典民主制是人类历史上第一个民主制度。公民通过公民大会（Ekklesia）直接投票决策，五百人议事会（Boule）准备议案，十将军（Strategos）领导军事与外交——这是古典时期最具实权的职位。执政官（Archon）至古典时期已多为抽签产生的礼仪性职务，陪审法庭（Dikasterion）司法审判。所有公民享有平等发言权（Isegoria），决策通过多数表决。
description.en: Athenian Democracy was humanity's first democratic system. Citizens voted directly in the Assembly (Ekklesia), the Council of 500 (Boule) prepared legislation, and Generals (Strategoi) — the most powerful office in the classical period — led military and foreign affairs. The Archonship had become a largely ceremonial role filled by lot by the classical era. The People's Courts (Dikasterion) dispensed justice. All citizens enjoyed equal right to speak (Isegoria), with decisions made by majority vote.
